page: Microsoft Azure E32nds_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance running on Microsoft Hyper-V virtualization. Powered by an x86_64 Intel processor, the instance provides 32 dedicated vCPUs and 256 GB of system RAM, maintaining an 8.0 GB memory-to-vCPU ratio. It also features integrated high-speed local storage comprising a 1890 GB NVMe SSD, alongside support for Azure Premium Storage tiers.

The configuration emphasizes network and storage throughput for data-heavy workloads. Its dedicated 32-core compute allocation combined with 1890 GB of high-speed local NVMe flash storage facilitates low-latency I/O operations without depending solely on remote block volumes. The instance does not include integrated hardware accelerators or GPUs, nor does it provide complimentary public IPv4 addresses, which must be routed or provisioned separately.

From an architectural standpoint, the instance balances substantial memory density with high-capacity local scratch storage. This profile yields high resource efficiency for environments that demand rapid in-memory processing paired with fast local disk caching or temporary staging areas, minimizing data transfer delays over the network.

Microsoft Azure E32nds_v6 is suited for large relational databases, in-memory caching systems, transactional datastores, data analytics engines, and enterprise ETL pipelines requiring large memory working sets and fast local NVMe paging.
